decisive_items: Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
response.rationale: Multiple myeloma is more likely due to the combination of abnormal paraprotein bands, monoclonal IgG-κ protein, and hypercellular marrow with plasma cell infiltration, which are characteristic of this condition.

rejected.why: While the patient has elevated serum cryoglobulin levels and cryoprotein precipitate, the presence of multiple myeloma features takes precedence.
